answers.how: The pen's fitted acceleration is about 2760 px/s², giving 281.6 px/m. The plant is about 29 px tall, so its height is 29/281.6.
Using the acceleration-derived scale of 281.6 px/m, the plant's approximately 22 px width gives 22/281.6.
The table spans approximately 454 px horizontally. Dividing by the acceleration-derived scale of 281.6 px/m gives its width.
The AC spans approximately 226 px horizontally. Dividing by the acceleration-derived scale of 281.6 px/m gives its width.
The phone to the plant's right is approximately 22 px wide. Using 281.6 px/m gives 22/281.6.
A quadratic fit to the pen's vertical positions gives approximately y=-11+6t+1380t² pixels. At 0.2 s, its speed is about 558 px/s; dividing by 281.6 px/m gives 1.98 m/s.
The fitted pen trajectory gives a speed of approximately 1110 px/s at 0.4 s. Dividing by the acceleration-derived scale of 281.6 px/m gives 3.94 m/s.
